features.description: Opening a PDF file renders its pages with continuous scrolling
Only pages near the viewport are drawn while scrolling a long book
Speed budgets for first page, scrolling, jumping and cache memory run in scripts/verify.sh and fail on regression
An imported book is still listed and opens after a page reload, without re-importing
The table of contents panel lists the book's outline and jumps to a chosen chapter
Bookmarks can be added, listed, jumped to and removed, and survive a reload
Selected text can be highlighted; highlights stay aligned at any scale and survive a reload
Notes can be attached to a highlight or a page, listed in a panel, and survive a reload
The app installs as a PWA and its shell opens offline
A book and its annotations added on one device appear on another device
Each book reopens at the last reading position
Dark and sepia themes and zoom/fit modes are available and persist
The library shows covers and reading progress, with sort and filter
A book's highlights and notes export to a Markdown file
Full-text search in the open book lists matches and jumps to each one
